description: Install gptwol with the full Phase-1b addon stack: addon-oidc (browser UI login for LAN users), addon-ssl (internal CA cert for HTTPS), and addon-oauth2-proxy (M2M Bearer-JWT gateway). Verifies that oauth2-proxy starts in HTTPS mode (because addon-ssl ships certs), listens on bearer_listen_port, validates against the Zitadel-registered gptwol-api audience, and locks the upstream gptwol port (5000) to loopback via iptables. addon-acme is intentionally omitted — livetest can't reach Cloudflare for real ACME issuance; addon-ssl's internal CA fills the same slot for cert validation.
